school: 无产阶级革命思想/毛泽东思想体系
historical_significance: 杨尚昆（1907-1998），四川潼南人，中国共产党、中华人民共和国卓越的政治工作领导人。从川东地下党创建者到中共中央办公厅主任（1988-1993），从中央书记处书记到中华人民共和国主席（1988-1993），一生致力于党的组织建设、情报工作和政治体制运行。在土地革命时期担任中共中央秘书长，长征中负责中央机关后勤与通信保障；抗日战争和解放战争期间主持陕甘宁边区工作，为中央根据地建设作出重要贡献；改革开放后担任中共中央办公厅主任、中央书记处书记等职，是中国共产党政治体制高效运转的关键组织者。

cross_references.description_zh: 杨尚昆是毛泽东政治体制建设思想的重要执行者和党的组织工作核心人物
cross_references.description_en: Yang Shangkun was an important executor of Mao Zedong's political system construction thought and a core figure in party organizational work

modes.definition_zh: 在复杂政治体制中，通过建立高效的中枢协调机制，确保各系统之间的信息流通、资源调配和决策执行的无缝衔接。杨尚昆在担任中共中央办公厅主任期间，构建了中央决策与地方执行之间的高效信息通道和协调网络。此法强调中枢机构作为信息枢纽和行动调度中心的角色，通过精准的信息整合和协调安排，使整个政治体制高效运转。
modes.definition_en: In complex political systems, establishing efficient central coordination mechanisms to ensure seamless information flow, resource allocation, and decision execution across all systems. During his tenure as Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, Yang Shangkun constructed efficient information channels and coordination networks between central decision-making and local implementation. This method emphasizes the hub role of central institutions in information integration and coordination, enabling entire political systems to operate efficiently.
modes.source_chapter: 杨尚昆担任中共中央办公厅主任期间（1988-1993）的中枢协调实践
modes.key_quote_zh: 办公厅是党中央的后勤部，也是指挥部
modes.key_quote_en: The General Office is both the logistics department and command center of the Central Committee
process_zh: 识别政治体制各系统的信息断点和资源瓶颈
建立跨部门高效沟通机制
设计信息整合与分发的标准化流程
构建决策执行的跟踪反馈系统
持续优化中枢协调网络以提高整体运行效率
process_en: Identify information gaps and resource bottlenecks across political system subsystems
Establish efficient cross-departmental communication mechanisms
Design standardized procedures for information integration and distribution
Build tracking and feedback systems for decision execution
Continuously optimize central coordination networks to improve overall operational efficiency
modes.modern_applications_zh: 任中办主任期间，杨尚昆构建了中央与地方之间高效的信息传递和协调机制，确保党中央决策迅速准确传达至各级执行部门。
modes.modern_applications_en: As Director of the General Office, Yang Shangkun constructed efficient information transmission and coordination mechanisms between central and local levels, ensuring CPC Central Committee decisions were rapidly and accurately conveyed to all executive departments.
modes.modern_parallel_zh: 大型企业总部运营中心的跨部门协调；政府间多层级治理体系的运作优化。
modes.thinking_skill_zh: 中枢不是简单的传声筒——它是整个系统的神经中枢，信息在这里被理解、整合和重新分配。
modes.pitfalls_zh: 过度集中可能导致信息瓶颈；中枢协调员能力不足会放大系统低效；过度依赖中枢可能削弱基层自主性。

verification.evidence: 旧世代载荷 v6 复刻落盘（Phase21-R6 批1）；引文与出处未独立核验，入库前须走核验流程

modes.definition_zh: 在极端危险的政治环境中，通过隐蔽身份、建立秘密联络网络和组织地下情报系统来推进革命目标。杨尚昆在1930年代重庆担任中共南方局成员期间，创建了复杂的地下情报网络和组织体系。此法强调在白色恐怖环境下保持组织生存、获取关键信息并有效执行秘密任务的系统性能力。
modes.definition_en: Advancing revolutionary goals through concealed identity, establishing secret communication networks and underground intelligence systems in extreme political environments. During the 1930s in Chongqing as a member of the CPC South Bureau, Yang Shangkun created complex underground intelligence networks and organizational systems. This method emphasizes systematic capability to maintain organizational survival, obtain critical information, and effectively execute secret missions under white terror conditions.
modes.source_chapter: 杨尚昆重庆南方局地下工作实践（1930年代）
modes.key_quote_zh: 地下工作没有硝烟，但同样需要流血牺牲的精神
modes.key_quote_en: Underground work has no smoke, but equally demands the spirit of blood sacrifice
process_zh: 评估目标环境的政治风险和监控强度
建立多层次秘密联络网络
设计身份伪装和信息传递方案
培养和管理地下人员安全体系
在危险环境中持续获取和传递关键情报
process_en: Assess political risks and surveillance intensity of target environment
Establish multi-layered secret communication networks
Design identity cover and information transmission protocols
Develop and manage underground personnel security systems
Continuously obtain and transmit critical intelligence within dangerous environments
modes.modern_applications_zh: 在重庆南方局期间，杨尚昆创建了覆盖西南地区的地下情报网络，为中共中央提供了大量关键军政情报。
modes.modern_applications_en: During Chongqing South Bureau tenure, Yang Shangkun created an underground intelligence network covering Southwest China, providing the CPC Central Committee with extensive critical military and political intelligence.
modes.modern_parallel_zh: 竞争环境中的商业情报收集；组织安全中的反监控策略。
modes.thinking_skill_zh: 在敌人的地盘上工作——你的身份就是最精密的武器，每一个日常行为都可能是掩护。
modes.pitfalls_zh: 过度谨慎可能错失行动时机；情报网络被渗透可能导致系统性崩溃；地下工作容易与群众脱离。

verification.evidence: 旧世代载荷 v6 复刻落盘（Phase21-R6 批1）；引文与出处未独立核验，入库前须走核验流程

modes.domain_zh: 大规模后勤组织与调度
modes.definition_zh: 在战争或大规模政治运动中，通过系统化组织后勤保障体系确保前线作战和后方建设的物资供应、人员调配和信息传递。杨尚昆在长征中负责中央机关的后勤与通信保障，在解放战争中组织陕甘宁边区的物资供应体系。此法强调后勤保障不是简单的物资搬运，而是战略决策执行的关键支撑系统。
modes.definition_en: Systematically organizing logistics support systems during wars or large-scale political movements to ensure material supply, personnel deployment and information transmission for front-line operations and rear-area construction. Yang Shangkun was responsible for central organs' logistics and communication support during the Long March, and organized material supply systems in the Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia Border Region during the Liberation War. This method emphasizes that logistics support is not simple material搬运 but a key supporting system for strategic decision execution.
modes.source_chapter: 杨尚昆长征后勤与陕甘宁边区建设工作（1934-1948）
modes.key_quote_zh: 后勤工作虽不显赫，却是胜负的关键
modes.key_quote_en: Logistics work may not be glamorous, but it determines victory or defeat
process_zh: 评估后勤需求规模和紧迫程度
建立分层级的物资储备和分发体系
设计多路径运输方案以分散风险
统筹通信保障确保信息畅通
根据战略变化动态调整后勤资源配置
process_en: Assess logistics demand scale and urgency
Establish hierarchical material reserves and distribution systems
Design multi-route transportation plans to diversify risks
Coordinate communication support ensuring information flow
Dynamically adjust logistics resource allocation based on strategic changes
modes.modern_applications_zh: 长征中负责中央机关后勤与通信保障，确保毛泽东等领导人能够安全指挥红军战略转移。
modes.modern_applications_en: Responsible for central organs' logistics and communication support during the Long March, ensuring leaders like Mao Zedong could safely command Red Army strategic relocation.
modes.modern_parallel_zh: 全球供应链体系设计；灾难应急响应中的资源调度。
modes.thinking_skill_zh: 看不见的后勤决定看得见的胜利——前线的每一发子弹都来自后方的精密计算。
modes.pitfalls_zh: 过度关注后勤可能分散战略注意力；后勤保障体系过于复杂会增加管理成本；在资源极度匮乏环境下难以完美执行。

verification.evidence: 旧世代载荷 v6 复刻落盘（Phase21-R6 批1）；引文与出处未独立核验，入库前须走核验流程

modes.definition_zh: 通过系统性地构建和完善政党组织体系、干部管理制度和工作规范，确保政治组织的长期稳定性和执行力。杨尚昆在党的多个历史阶段参与和推动了重要的组织建设工作，从川东地下党组织创建到改革开放后中央机关的制度化建设。此法强调组织建设是政治目标得以实现的根本保障，优秀的组织体系能使平庸的人做出卓越的贡献。
modes.definition_en: Systematically constructing and perfecting political organization systems, cadre management institutions, and work standards to ensure long-term stability and execution capability of political organizations. Yang Shangkun participated in and promoted important organizational construction work across multiple historical periods of the party, from founding underground organizations in eastern Sichuan to institutionalizing central organs during reform era. This method emphasizes that organizational construction is the fundamental guarantee for achieving political goals — excellent organizational systems enable mediocre people to make extraordinary contributions.
modes.source_chapter: 杨尚昆参与党的组织建设历程（1926-1990年代）
modes.key_quote_zh: 组织的力量大于任何个人的力量
modes.key_quote_en: Organizational power exceeds that of any individual
process_zh: 分析现有组织体系的薄弱环节
设计适应当前任务的组织架构
建立干部选拔培养和使用机制
制定规范化的工作流程和制度
通过制度化建设保证组织传承
process_en: Analyze weak points in existing organizational systems
Design organizational structures adapted to current missions
Establish cadre selection, cultivation and utilization mechanisms
Develop standardized work procedures and systems
Ensure organizational succession through institutionalized construction
modes.modern_applications_zh: 从川东地下党创建到改革开放后中央机关制度化建设，杨尚昆始终重视组织建设对革命事业的基础性作用。
modes.modern_applications_en: From founding underground organizations in eastern Sichuan to institutionalizing central organs during reform era, Yang Shangkun consistently emphasized the foundational role of organizational construction for revolutionary causes.
modes.modern_parallel_zh: 科技公司的组织文化建设；非营利机构的治理结构完善。
modes.thinking_skill_zh: 个人能力再强也有限——好的制度让普通人成为英雄，坏的制度使天才变成庸人。
modes.pitfalls_zh: 过度制度化可能导致官僚主义；制度设计脱离实际可能适得其反；变革阻力来自既得利益群体。

verification.evidence: 旧世代载荷 v6 复刻落盘（Phase21-R6 批1）；引文与出处未独立核验，入库前须走核验流程

modes.definition_zh: 在敌强我弱的政治环境中，通过创新的通信手段和联络方式确保关键信息的秘密传递。杨尚昆在重庆南方局工作期间，设计了多套隐蔽通信方案，包括密写技术、地下交通线和秘密电台使用。此法强调在信息被严密监控的环境下，通过多层次通信保障确保核心信息的可靠传递。
modes.definition_en: Ensuring secret transmission of critical information through innovative communication methods and contact approaches in politically disadvantaged environments. During his Chongqing South Bureau work, Yang Shangkun designed multiple covert communication schemes including invisible ink techniques, underground transport lines and secret radio operations. This method emphasizes multi-layered communication assurance to ensure reliable transmission of core information when communications are strictly monitored.
modes.source_chapter: 杨尚昆重庆南方局秘密通信实践（1930年代）
modes.key_quote_zh: 没有保密就没有生存，没有联络就没有胜利
modes.key_quote_en: Without secrecy there is no survival, without communication there is no victory
process_zh: 评估敌方监控能力和情报获取手段
设计多套并行通信方案以分散风险
培训专职通信人员掌握秘密传递技术
建立应急替换和备用联络通道
定期更换通信方式和联络暗号
process_en: Assess enemy surveillance capabilities and intelligence gathering methods
Design multiple parallel communication schemes to diversify risks
Train dedicated communicators in secret transmission techniques
Establish emergency replacement and backup communication channels
Regularly change communication methods and contact codes
modes.modern_applications_zh: 在重庆南方局期间，杨尚昆设计了覆盖多地区的秘密通信网络，确保中共中央与西南地区地下组织的信息畅通。
modes.modern_applications_en: During Chongqing South Bureau tenure, Yang Shangkun designed multi-regional secret communication networks ensuring uninterrupted information flow between CPC Central Committee and underground organizations in Southwest China.
modes.modern_parallel_zh: 加密通信系统设计；安全敏感组织的内部信息传递机制。
modes.thinking_skill_zh: 在监控无处不在的时代——最好的保密不是不说话，而是让所有人以为你在说废话。
modes.pitfalls_zh: 通信系统过于复杂容易出错；过度保密可能导致信息传递延误；关键人员被俘可能暴露整个网络。

verification.evidence: 旧世代载荷 v6 复刻落盘（Phase21-R6 批1）；引文与出处未独立核验，入库前须走核验流程

modes.domain_zh: 根据地建设与地方治理
modes.domain_en: Base Area Construction and Local Governance
modes.definition_zh: 在战略根据地区域，通过系统性的经济建设、社会改造和政治动员，将边缘地区建设成为革命力量的稳固基地。杨尚昆在陕甘宁边区工作期间，推动了农业生产、工业建设和文化教育的全方位发展。此法强调在资源匮乏的边远地区，通过自给自足的综合建设模式实现政治目标的可持续支撑。
modes.definition_en: In strategic base areas, systematizing economic construction, social transformation and political mobilization to transform peripheral regions into solid revolutionary power bases. During his work in the Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia Border Region, Yang Shangkun promoted comprehensive development of agricultural production, industrial construction and cultural education. This method emphasizes that in resource-scarce remote areas, self-sufficient comprehensive construction models achieve sustainable support for political goals.
modes.source_chapter: 杨尚昆陕甘宁边区工作实践（1937-1948）
modes.key_quote_en: Do it yourself and you'll have plenty of clothing and food
process_zh: 评估根据地的资源和人口条件
制定因地制宜的经济发展计划
组织群众参与根据地建设运动
建立基层政权和民主管理制度
通过文化教育和宣传提高民众政治觉悟
process_en: Assess base area resources and population conditions
Develop localized economic development plans
Organize mass participation in base area construction movements
Establish grassroots政权 and democratic management systems
Raise masses' political awareness through cultural education and propaganda
modes.modern_applications_zh: 在陕甘宁边区，杨尚昆推动了大生产运动和地方政权建设，为抗战胜利奠定了物质基础。
modes.modern_applications_en: In the Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia Border Region, Yang Shangkun promoted the Great Production Movement and local regime construction, laying material foundation for victory in the Anti-Japanese War.
modes.modern_parallel_zh: 欠发达地区的综合发展策略；战后重建中的社区治理。
modes.thinking_skill_zh: 根据地不是简单的避难所——它是新社会的试验场，每一寸土地都要产出革命的果实。
modes.pitfalls_zh: 边区建设周期长、见效慢；过度动员可能引起群众疲劳；资源极度匮乏时难以平衡建设与生存需求。

verification.evidence: 旧世代载荷 v6 复刻落盘（Phase21-R6 批1）；引文与出处未独立核验，入库前须走核验流程

modes.definition_zh: 将来自多源、多渠道的情报信息进行筛选、整合和深度分析，为高层决策提供准确可靠的参考依据。杨尚昆在中共中央秘书长和中办主任任内，建立了完整的情报收集、整理和上报体系。此法强调信息不是越多越好——关键是从海量碎片中提取高价值的战略判断，为决策者提供清晰的方向指引。
modes.definition_en: Filtering, integrating and deeply analyzing intelligence information from multiple sources and channels to provide accurate and reliable reference for high-level decision-making. As Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and Director of the General Office, Yang Shangkun established complete intelligence collection, organization and reporting systems. This method emphasizes that more information is not always better — the key is extracting high-value strategic judgments from massive fragments to provide clear directional guidance for decision-makers.
modes.source_chapter: 杨尚昆中共中央秘书长和中办主任任内情报工作（1930年代-1980年代）
modes.key_quote_zh: 情报的价值不在于数量而在于质量
modes.key_quote_en: The value of intelligence lies not in quantity but in quality
process_zh: 建立多渠道情报收集网络
对原始信息进行交叉验证和去伪存真
将碎片信息整合为系统性分析报告
提炼关键战略判断供决策参考
建立情报反馈和效果评估机制
process_en: Establish multi-channel intelligence collection networks
Cross-verify and filter raw information for authenticity
Integrate fragmented information into systematic analysis reports
Extract key strategic judgments for decision reference
Establish intelligence feedback and effectiveness evaluation mechanisms
modes.modern_applications_zh: 任中共中央秘书长期间，杨尚昆建立了覆盖全国的情报网络，为党中央提供了高质量的战略情报分析。
modes.modern_applications_en: As Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Yang Shangkun established nationwide intelligence networks providing high-quality strategic analysis to the party leadership.
modes.modern_parallel_zh: 大数据分析中的信息提取与决策支持；商业竞争情报的系统化整合。
modes.thinking_skill_zh: 信息过载是最大的敌人——真正有价值的是从噪音中过滤出信号的能力。
modes.pitfalls_zh: 信息整合者能力不足会导致决策误导；过度筛选可能丢失重要边缘信号；情报来源可靠性难以完全保证。

verification.evidence: 旧世代载荷 v6 复刻落盘（Phase21-R6 批1）；引文与出处未独立核验，入库前须走核验流程

modes.definition_zh: 在政治体制已建立的基础上，通过持续的制度维护和流程优化，确保既有制度的稳定运行和适应性改进。杨尚昆在改革开放后担任中办主任、中央书记处书记和国家主席期间，致力于维护和完善中国共产党的政治体制运作。此法强调在变革时期保持制度连续性的价值——不是所有改革都需要推倒重来，有时精心维护比大胆创新更重要。
modes.definition_en: On the foundation of established political systems, through continuous system maintenance and process optimization ensuring stable operation and adaptive improvement of existing institutions. During his tenure as Director of the General Office, Secretary-General of the Central Secretariat and President after reform era, Yang Shangkun dedicated himself to maintaining and perfecting the operational mechanisms of CPC political systems. This method emphasizes the value of institutional continuity in transformative periods — not all reforms require starting from scratch; sometimes careful maintenance is more important than bold innovation.
modes.source_chapter: 杨尚昆改革开放后政治体制维护工作（1978-1993）
modes.key_quote_zh: 制度稳定是国家长治久安的基础
modes.key_quote_en: Institutional stability is the foundation of long-term national peace
process_zh: 评估现有制度的运行效率和薄弱环节
识别需要紧急改进的关键流程节点
制定渐进式制度优化方案
在保持核心框架不变的前提下进行微调
通过制度化反馈机制持续改进
process_en: Evaluate operational efficiency and weak points of existing systems
Identify critical process nodes requiring urgent improvement
Develop incremental system optimization plans
Make fine adjustments while maintaining core frameworks unchanged
Continuously improve through institutionalized feedback mechanisms
modes.modern_applications_zh: 改革开放后，杨尚昆致力于维护和完善党的政治体制运作，确保国家主席职位和政治制度的稳定运行。
modes.modern_applications_en: After reform era, Yang Shangkun dedicated himself to maintaining and perfecting CPC political system operations, ensuring stable operation of the presidency and political institutions.
modes.modern_parallel_zh: 大型组织的流程优化；成熟企业管理体系的持续改进。
modes.thinking_skill_zh: 维护不是被动保守——精心呵护现有体制使其更好地服务新目标，本身就是一种战略智慧。
modes.pitfalls_zh: 过度维护可能阻碍必要的制度创新；既得利益者可能利用体制维护抵制改革；渐进改进在危机面前反应迟缓。

verification.evidence: 旧世代载荷 v6 复刻落盘（Phase21-R6 批1）；引文与出处未独立核验，入库前须走核验流程

modes.definition_zh: 通过系统化的选拔、培训和实践锻炼机制，培养符合特定历史阶段需求的政治干部和管理人才。杨尚昆在长期的革命生涯中，始终重视干部队伍建设和人才培养工作，从基层干部到高级领导干部的选拔培养都有他的贡献。此法强调政治人才不是自然生成的——需要通过严格的实践考验、系统的理论学习和持续的岗位锻炼来塑造。
modes.definition_en: Through systematic selection, training and practical exercise mechanisms to cultivate political cadres and management talents meeting the needs of specific historical periods. Throughout his long revolutionary career, Yang Shangkun consistently valued cadre team construction and talent cultivation, contributing to the selection and training of both grassroots and senior cadres. This method emphasizes that political talents are not naturally generated — they require rigorous practical tests, systematic theoretical study and continuous positional exercise to shape.
modes.source_chapter: 杨尚昆干部培养与选拔工作实践（贯穿整个革命生涯）
modes.key_quote_zh: 培养干部就是培养未来
modes.key_quote_en: Cultivating cadres is cultivating the future
process_zh: 根据工作需要确定干部选拔标准
建立多层次的人才发现和培养机制
通过重要岗位锻炼检验和塑造人才
将理论学习与实践经验有机结合
建立干部梯队保证事业传承
process_en: Determine cadre selection criteria based on work needs
Establish multi-level talent discovery and cultivation mechanisms
Test and shape talents through important positional exercises
Organically combine theoretical study with practical experience
Establish cadre echelons to ensure organizational succession
modes.modern_applications_zh: 杨尚昆在革命和建设各时期都重视干部培养，为党的事业储备了大量优秀政治人才。
modes.modern_applications_en: Throughout revolutionary and construction periods, Yang Shangkun consistently valued cadre cultivation, reserving大量 excellent political talents for the party's cause.
modes.modern_parallel_zh: 企业高管继任计划；智库人才梯队建设。
modes.thinking_skill_zh: 事业能否延续不取决于个人能力多强，而取决于你能否培养出接你班的人。
modes.pitfalls_zh: 培养周期长短期内难以见效；选拔标准过于僵化可能错过优秀人才；过度保护可能导致干部依赖心理。

verification.evidence: 旧世代载荷 v6 复刻落盘（Phase21-R6 批1）；引文与出处未独立核验，入库前须走核验流程

modes.definition_zh: 在复杂的历史进程中，准确认知自身所处历史阶段的角色定位，并在革命、建设和改革的不同时期灵活调整工作重心。杨尚昆从川东地下工作者到国家主席，经历了中国近现代史上几乎所有重要历史转折。此法强调个人和组织的战略定位必须与历史进程相契合——在正确的时间做正确的事，比单纯的能力发挥更重要。
modes.definition_en: Accurately cognizing one's own role positioning within complex historical processes, and flexibly adjusting work focus across different periods of revolution, construction and reform. From underground worker in eastern Sichuan to President of China, Yang Shangkun experienced almost all major historical turning points in modern Chinese history. This method emphasizes that personal and organizational strategic positioning must align with historical processes — doing the right thing at the right time is more important than pure capability demonstration.
modes.source_chapter: 杨尚昆一生的历史角色演变（1926-1998）
modes.key_quote_en: Stand on the correct side of history
process_zh: 准确判断当前所处的历史阶段特征
评估个人和组织在阶段中的定位和优势
根据历史任务调整工作重心和资源投入
把握历史转折的关键时机果断行动
在角色转换中保持核心价值的连续性
process_en: Accurately judge characteristics of current historical period
Evaluate personal and organizational positioning and advantages within the phase
Adjust work focus and resource allocation based on historical missions
Seize critical moments of historical transitions to act decisively
Maintain core value continuity during role transitions
modes.modern_applications_zh: 杨尚昆从地下工作者到革命将领，再到政治体制核心建设者，每个历史阶段都做出了正确的角色定位。
modes.modern_applications_en: From underground worker to revolutionary commander to core builder of political systems, Yang Shangkun made correct role positioning in every historical phase.
modes.modern_parallel_zh: 个人职业规划中的战略定位；企业转型期的角色重构。
modes.thinking_skill_zh: 历史不等待任何人——你能做的最好的事情就是在对的时间出现在对的地点做对的事。
modes.pitfalls_zh: 历史判断失误可能导致不可逆的战略错误；角色转换过程中的身份焦虑可能影响决策质量；过度追求定位可能导致行动犹豫。

verification.evidence: 旧世代载荷 v6 复刻落盘（Phase21-R6 批1）；引文与出处未独立核验，入库前须走核验流程
